crossroads_guard_1: Crossroads guard, south gate - the only one. Every road in the Barrens meets outside it: north to Orgrimmar's country, east to Ratchet, south to Camp Taurajo. Every caravan between the coasts comes through here, and so does everything that hunts them.
crossroads_traveler: I sell off my back, town to town. Passing through - always passing through. Ratchet tomorrow if the Raider's Rest road is open, and lately it hasn't been.
crossroads_caravan_guard: Dresk. I ride guard on the caravans out of the Crossroads. They leave with four wheels each and I'm meant to bring them home the same way. The Kolkar and the quilboar have other ideas this season.
crossroads_quartermaster: Ruka, quartermaster. Every warband that comes through the Crossroads gets counted, armed and sent on - north against the Kolkar, south against the Bristlebacks. That's the job, and I'm short of everything it takes.
crossroads_runner: Kol. I run messages between the Crossroads and Orgrimmar. Can't talk long - the Warchief's people want this by nightfall and my legs don't fly.
crossroads_bounty_reader: Grukan. I keep the Crossroads bounty board. Kolkar khans, quilboar chieftains, a thing in the Wailing Caverns nobody's come back from. It's full of bounties no one's fool enough to take. Except you, maybe.
crossroads_retired_warrior: Thokk. One-Eye, they call me, for the reason you'd think - I left it in Ashenvale, at the Warsong line. Lost the taste for fighting somewhere after that. I mind the gate road and tell the young ones what it costs.
crossroads_goblin_peddler: Snix Cogsworth, purveyor. Trinkets, baubles, one careful owner! Business was better before your lot turned up and stopped being afraid of dying - nobody buys a lucky charm they don't think they need.
crossroads_beltelf_envoy: Envoy Thaelis, of Silvermoon. I am here to report on the Horde's holdings in the Barrens. So far my report reads: dust, kodo, and a town with one gate. Silvermoon sends its regards anyway.
crossroads_human_traveler: Corwin Hale. Long way from Stormwind, and a longer way back, I suspect. I drive for the caravans now. The Horde's been fairer to me than I had any right to expect.
crossroads_child: I counted eleven caravans today! Ma says I'm not allowed to count the goblin ones any more, because they count me back and send her a bill.
crossroads_sergra: Sergra Darkthorn. I command the Crossroads. The Kolkar hold the plains to the east, the Bristlebacks the thorn to the south, and something is wrong with the water at the oases. Keep your business quick, and if you want work, I have more than I have soldiers.
crossroads_innkeeper: Boorka. This is the Crossroads inn - cots in the back, stew in the front. Make this your hearth and the Barrens can't lose you, however far out you get.
crossroads_flight_master: Hurak, windrider master. The Crossroads is the busiest roost in Kalimdor - every route crosses here. I fly to anywhere you've already walked to. Name it.
crossroads_riding_trainer: Vash'ka. I teach ridin', mon - raptor, wolf, kodo, it all come down to who be in charge. You got to be level enough and you got to have da coin. Den I show you.
ct_crossroads: Naruk. I train every discipline at the Crossroads. Half the Horde's recruits come through this town on the way to somewhere worse - show me what you can do, and bring coin.
pt_crossroads_forge: Grokk. Mining and smithing, both halves. The town forge is on the west side, by the sawmill - bring ore and I'll show you what it's for.
pt_crossroads_herbs: Vashka, apothecary. Herbalism and alchemy. The Barrens grows more than it looks like it does, especially round the oases. I'll show you what to pull and what to do with it after.
pt_crossroads_wood: Naruk the woodwright - no relation to the trainer, whatever he says. Woodcutting and woodworking. The Crossroads sawmill is on the west side of town.
pt_crossroads_hide: Rokan, tanner. Skinning, leatherworking, tailoring and cooking - the Barrens is all hide and meat, so there's no better place to learn the four of them.
pt_crossroads_essence: I teach engineering here. Metal, a crystal out of an ore vein, and a steady hand. The goblins in Ratchet will tell you they do it better. They do it louder.
